title_en: Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More
summary_en: We are here at the Honda Center in Anaheim, California, for Horizons: A Carousel of Progress, also known as D23's Disney Eexperiences Showcase, and we'll be covering all the big news from Disney Parks (Walt Disney World, Disneyland, International Parks!), Disney Cruise Line (Disney Believe!), and much more.
body_en:
We are here at the Honda Center in Anaheim, California, for Horizons: A Carousel of Progress, also known as D23's Disney Experiences Showcase, and we'll be covering all the big news from Disney Parks (Walt Disney World, Disneyland, International Parks!), Disney Cruise Line (Disney Believe!), and much more.
We'll be updating this article live as the show goes on, which you can also watch on Disney+ right now!
The upcoming Avengers Infinity Defense at Avengers Campus at Disneyland's Disney California Adventure will officially star some of the biggest names in the MCU, including Robert Downey Jr.'s Iron Man, Chris Hemsworth's Thor, Anthony Mackie's Captain America, Jeremy Renner's Hawkeye, and Iman Vellani's Ms. Marvel.
Avengers Infinity Defense is set to open in 2028 and will see guests helping reassmble the Avengers to battle King Thanos.
Alongside a glimpse of the new scenes set in the 1980s, it was revealed that Disney Legend Jamie Lee Curtis and Emmy-winning actor Bryan Cranston will be joining the cast as the new version of the attraction's Mom and Dad, respectively.
At the showcase, Disney Experiences Chairman Thomas Mazloum revealed that the team is "bringing the Yeti back to life inside Expedition Everest at Disney's Animal Kingdom!"
Leslie Iwerks' The Imagineering Story is one of the most beloved documentaries on Disney+, and it was just revealed that we'd be getting a second season in early 2028.
